sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
title: A Little Give
prose: Irekha presses a repaired seam into the shallows. The bundles bend separately, and the water stays outside.

choices.label: Watch the test
choices.line: The repair holds because its parts still have room to move.

choices.label: Ask about the reeds
choices.line: Irekha takes the cut stems and leaves the rooted strip beside the water.
